name: deepchat-cli
tagline_zh: 当你想在终端里直接调模型、跑OCR、查MCP，又懒得开界面——这个Skill把DeepChat的CLI控制台搬进对。
tagline_en: Skip the GUI—run DeepChat's CLI from chat for inference, OCR, MCP, and artifact checks, all in one command.
desc_en: Use DeepChat's bundled CLI control plane for model inference, image/video/speech generation, transcription, OCR, artifact inspection, public configuration, Skills, and MCP operations. Activate when a user asks to invoke DeepChat capabilities that are not already exposed as a more specific tool, compare models, run a benchmark, inspect DeepChat runtime state, or manage DeepChat through the CLI.
why_zh: 同类工具只做单点调用，它却把整个CLI控制面暴露给对话，连配置和技能管理都能聊着办。
why_en: Unlike single-purpose wrappers, it exposes the full CLI control plane—config, skills, MCP—right inside your chat.
